resources.string: Keep Samsung deep-sleeping apps visible inside the apps selected in Vector / LSPosed.
Only apps selected in Vector / LSPosed see Samsung auto-disabled apps as enabled. Background restrictions and your deep sleep list stay in place. Manually disabled apps keep their original state.
Enable SleepStore in Vector / LSPosed, select the stores and updaters you use, then restart those apps. No Runner step is needed. Android 16 with Samsung’s auto-disable API is required.
This indicator checks this app only. Injection into the selected apps and update detection must be verified separately.
